title: The Hebrews' Understanding of God
description: From their earliest understanding of God to their latest.
items: YHWH is a local, tribal god; El is the chief of all the gods.
Of all the gods of the nations, YHWH is the mightiest by far.
YHWH and El are one and the same; YHWH is king of all gods.
YHWH Elohim is the only god; the others are nothing or demons.
YHWH Elohim is the ground of all being, beyond all thought.
